generatedProse.practice-connection: From here, analysis, evaluation and synthesis are what you practise in every module across the School of Sport. Each time a brief says analyse or evaluate, each review that draws studies together, each argument you build rather than report, is these skills at work. They are also what research and professional practice in sport reward. Whether you work in the lab, on the training ground, in the clinic or in sport development, the ability to take evidence apart, weigh it, and build a reasoned case will serve you well beyond your degree.
